test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 3 days, while C and D together can complete the same work in 6 days. In how many days can A, B, C and D complete it together?
solution: Given: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 3 days, while C and D together can complete the same work in 6 days. Concept used: Total work = Work done per day (efficiency) × Total time taken Calculation: Let the work be 6 units and also let the efficiencies of A, B, C and D be represented by A, B, C and D respectively.
